Express Offers

Answer four questions. Get the whole contract.

Express mode asks you four things and fills the rest with standard Florida terms — 15-day inspection, deposit due in three days, seller pays the deed stamps, possession at closing. TransactPro assembles the full FAR/BAR AS-IS contract and every rider that goes with it, then shows you the lot to review before anything is sent. Need to change a term? Every field is right there.

  • Auto-fills buyer, property, price, terms, and dates — zero retyping
  • Florida contract logic built in, so nothing important is left blank
  • Review, e-sign, and send without ever leaving the app
  • Save and finish later — a half-written offer is never lost
